scripts.check: tsc -p . && bun run --filter '*' check && go -C api vet ./...
scripts.lint: bun run --filter '*' lint && cd api && golangci-lint run ./...
scripts.gen: go -C api generate ./... && bun scripts/fmt.ts apps/hq/src/lib/contract.gen.ts
scripts.test: bun test ./scripts && bun scripts/emulators.ts exec 'bun run test:emulated'
scripts.test:emulated: go -C api test -count=1 ./... && bun run --filter '*' test
